behaviour: Moving in first/third person turns the character toward actual movement and the camera follows the same heading.
A held movement gesture retains its world direction as the camera turns; neutral input resets its reference. Mouse look rotates the movement reference deliberately.
Attack snapshots keep their committed direction; movement turning resumes after recovery.
Camp, rooms, input release/blur, view change and restart reset or preserve the movement reference appropriately.
Graphics, overhead movement, balance and stored progression unchanged.
limitations: Browser checks use Chromium/SwiftShader and emulated mobile touch; no physical Safari timing measurement.
